title: Railway Security Breach Triggers $740K in AI Fraud
excerpt: Cloud provider Railway reports a security breach where hackers stole credentials and generated $740,000 in fraudulent AI usage.
body_html:
Cloud hosting provider Railway has reported a security incident involving unauthorized access to its infrastructure. According to the company, attackers exploited vulnerabilities to steal customer authentication secrets.

The breach resulted in approximately $740,000 in fraudulent AI usage charges. Additionally, the security compromise potentially exposed credentials affecting up to 100,000 workspaces on the platform.

Railway is addressing the incident and working to secure its systems following the unauthorized activity.
